description: Look up a B2B SaaS company in DemoPage's published grades of 450+ SaaS websites: whether visitors can see the product without booking a call, pricing transparency, self-serve signup, demo-form field friction, interactive click-tour detection, buyer Q&A, customer proof, and page speed. Use when a user asks to benchmark a known SaaS website's demo experience. Returns found=false for unlisted companies (call demopage_audit_website_live to grade any live URL). No sign-in required.

domainOrName.description: The company's domain or name, for example 'apollo.io' or 'Airtable'.
